# unfolding with Peg — Peggy Pei-Chun Hsieh (謝佩君)

> Bilingual (繁體中文 / English) personal site of Peggy Pei-Chun Hsieh, a
> learning experience designer in Taiwan who builds products with AI for the
> people who make learning happen. Currently at TalentLabs. The site covers her
> work, writing on learning design, AI, and building, and a job tracker.

Peggy designs learning experiences and builds AI-assisted tools for educators,
mentors, and L&D teams. She writes about learning experience design, AI in
education and safety, and shipping products as a solo builder.

## Key pages

- [Home (繁中)](https://studiounfolding.cc/): Who Peggy is and what she is working on.
- [Home (English)](https://studiounfolding.cc/en/): English introduction and current work.
- [About (繁中)](https://studiounfolding.cc/about/): Background and approach.
- [About (English)](https://studiounfolding.cc/en/about/): Background and approach in English.
- [Writing (繁中)](https://studiounfolding.cc/posts/): All posts, newest first.
- [Writing (English)](https://studiounfolding.cc/en/posts/): All posts in English.
